title: I Found A Cassette With My Name In Grandma's Cupboard #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you're cleaning Grandma's old cupboard.
You find a cassette tape. On it, someone wrote your name.
You play it on her old radio.
It's a little kid's voice. It's you, age five.
"Hello, big me. Don't go to Grandma's this year."
You laugh. You don't remember recording that.
The tape keeps going. "She's not Grandma anymore."
The cupboard door creaks behind you.
*"Found something nice, kanna?" Grandma asks, smiling.
The tape whispers, "Don't let her see this."
Would you hide the tape, or ask Grandma about it? Comment A or B.
